California Governor Signs Executive Order on AI Safety

California Governor Gavin Newsom has signed an executive order aimed at improving artificial intelligence (AI) safety. The order seeks to implement oversight before potential issues arise. Newsom also signed legislation related to post-production tax credits and bills intended to shield California elections from interference and increase transparency.
